summary: Roadside spot along US 23 in Scioto County, OH, where the Grass Knob tower was moved; the tower was since removed entirely.

facts.status_note: FFLOS says the tower was moved to this site along US Route 23 and was since removed entirely

access.note: Roadside spot along US Route 23 per FFLOS; no source says whether it is open to visitors

events.note: Chillicothe Gazette, October 27, 1934: a Grass Knob Tower north of Otway would be manned by Perry Bonner of Mt. Joy. The FFLOS site records do not mention 1934, so whether it is the tower later moved here is unconfirmed; the move date is not given
Registered on the FFLOS register September 3, 2014 as US 1559, OH 5; nominated by Mark

evidence.supports: tower moved to this site along US 23 from Brush Creek State Forest and since removed entirely
evidence.quote: Grass Knob Fire Tower was moved to this site along US Route 23 from Brush Creek State Forest. It was since removed entirely.

notes_for_editor: The Site #2 record gives no agency and no move date, so none is recorded. The 1934 staffing event is about the Grass Knob tower generally, not this roadside spot; its note says so. Sites 1 and 2 describe the same tower from each end of the move, and the records agree on that. Access is 'unknown': the roadside location along US 23 does not show whether the spot is open to visitors, so the story says no source states it and advises checking first. The county conflict for Brush Creek State Forest (Scioto per FFLOS, Adams per Wikipedia) is recorded in the Site #1 research file.
